About VPSLedger

An independent ledger of VPS prices: list price plus IPv4, backups and bandwidth, with the source and check date on every row.

  • How it’s kept. Prices are read only from providers’ own pages or public APIs, re-checked by a script and logged when they change. Unknowns stay blank; we never estimate a price. Details: methodology.
  • How it’s paid for. The ledger, calculator, comparisons and data are free. Revenue comes from optional Pro alerts and labeled newsletter sponsor slots. There are no affiliate links today. No one pays for placement.
  • Who runs it. VPSLedger is published by the same independent operator as the pricing ledgers O11y Watch, Ratecard and AuthCost. Source code: github.com/Basileion/vpsledger.
  • Contact. Corrections, sponsor questions or data requests: basileion.ops@gmail.com.
